task.description:
Step 4 — Write/verify the test specification for TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH.

Context: BACKEND-DEV has already added TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH to tests/integration/vld04_gate_test.zig as part of Step 3 implementation. Your task is to write/validate the formal test spec entry for this test case and confirm the implementation matches.

1. Read tests/integration/vld04_gate_test.zig to find the TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH test.
2. Read tests/specs/VLD-04.md (or equivalent) to check if TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH is documented there.
3. If VLD-04.md exists, add TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH spec entry if missing. If it doesn't exist, note that.
4. Confirm the implemented test covers: (a) PATCH with invalid body returns HTTP 422, (b) semantically_valid stays false in DB after the PATCH.
5. Confirm the test is properly isolated (per-test schema, no shared state).
6. Write your result: PASS if TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH is correctly specified and implemented, FAIL with gaps otherwise.

result.summary: TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH spec entry added to tests/specs/VLD-04.md (was missing). Implementation in tests/integration/vld04_gate_test.zig verified: (a) calls handlePatch with an invalid-graph PatchDefinitionBody and asserts status_code == 422, (b) queries process_definitions to assert semantically_valid = false. Fixture isolation confirmed: per-test UUID via seedDefinition, defer cleanup, no SkipZigTest, real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL (hard-fails if absent). Implementation matches design spec (src/design/wf03-gh816-vld04-patch-gate-fix.md) exactly.
